name: Colavita / Nonna Pia's Aged Balsamic Glaze (Smooth Reduction)
whyItWorks: Slow-simmered balsamic vinegar and cooked grape must reduced to a thick, syrupy glaze. Simmering burns off the sharp volatile acetic acid vapors that cause stomach burning in raw vinegar, leaving smooth, gentle sweet-tart flavor.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle lightly over baked chicken breast, roasted carrots, or sourdough toast.
watchOuts: Contains cooked grape sugars; a light drizzle provides ample flavor.
